sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, sitting top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, travel to Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. The league leaders are in excellent form with five consecutive wins before their most recent draw, and they face an Alsager side struggling at the bottom of the division with just 4 points from 10 matches.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host Dawley Town in a fixture that could see them close the two-point gap on leaders Sandbach if they secure victory. AFC Bridgnorth, third with 19 points, face a tricky away trip to Eccleshall, who occupy fifth place. Wolverhampton Casuals, level on points with Bridgnorth, host Wednesfield Community at home. Bilston Town (6th) travel to Foley Meir in a mid-table encounter. Barnton welcome Shawbury United in a battle between teams with contrasting recent form—Barnton have won their last match while Shawbury are on a difficult run. New Mills host Market Drayton Town in a fixture between struggling sides. Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a bottom-half clash. Crewe host Allscott Heath in another lower-table match. Brereton Social entertain Widnes Town, the division's bottommost club on just 2 points.
